dedupe_keys.name: danish energy agency energy producer census energiproducenttællingen power and district heating plants with fuel use and output plus district heating network fuel mix

description: The Energiproducenttællingen is the annual census in which every electricity and district heating producer that delivers to a public network reports fuel consumption and heat and power production for each of its plants, published by the Danish Energy Agency. Contents: a plant-level spreadsheet for the last three census years (the 2023 to 2025 file has about 8,600 rows) giving plant and unit ids, postcode, municipality, the district heating network each unit feeds, operating company and CVR number, plant type (central, decentral, industrial) and unit names, with fuel use by fuel and electricity and heat output; separate master-data tables list main fuels, and a district heating network file gives, for about 1,000 network-year rows from 2022 to 2024, heat delivered in TJ, the fuel and energy shares and CO2 emission factors under two allocation methods. Producer: Energistyrelsen, published under Danish rules on active dissemination of environmental information. Coverage: Denmark, all public power and heat producers. Format and access: Excel downloads on the agency's energy sector data page. Free; no licence stated. Caveats: units are identified by address and network, not coordinates, so mapping needs geocoding, and the files are census snapshots, not time-stamped operation data. Simulation uses: supply-side inventory for district heating and power system models, fuel-switch and emission scenarios, and heat network planning. Related records: the wind turbine register (data-denmark-ens-master-data-register-wind-turbines) and Energinet's Energi Data Service (data-energi-data-service-energinet).
